description: This file contains OEM/SOC specific functions for handling pre- and post-configuration of network bridges, including platform-specific operations based on instance types, and a function to retrieve vendor interfaces.

methods.name: HandlePreConfigVendor
methods.description: Performs platform-specific pre-configuration steps before creating/updating/deleting a bridge based on instance type.

methods.name: HandlePostConfigVendor
methods.description: Performs platform-specific post-configuration steps after creating/updating/deleting a bridge based on instance type.

methods.name: getVendorIfaces
methods.description: Returns NULL; placeholder for vendor interface retrieval.
